closure_policy.rules_mode_note: Historical M3.1 Link-zone fixtures used an explicit MR5 test-only override while the locked duel_flags=0 mismatch remained a configuration blocker. M3.2 resolves that blocker and re-runs the fixtures under the canonical lock-backed MR5 mode; no reachable Link path is classified NOT_APPLICABLE from the old mismatch.

subpath_classifications.rationale: The exact locked Swordsoul Deck A Extra Deck contains no Link Monster.
The locked Salamangreat monster pool is FIRE-only; its non-FIRE hand traps do not supply a special-summon candidate.

rows.why_pending: Constrained Blackout selection is proven, but official Blackout banished-trigger execution and Token result are not yet proven.
rows.fixture_strategy: Banish Blackout through an official pinned-card path or a real Blackout banish condition, then follow the official trigger and Token creation.
rows.required_observation_evidence: Blackout banished; official trigger accepted; Token passcode 20001444, public non-effect properties, owner/controller/location, and visible state transition.
rows.notes: Real pinned CardScript execution produced the banished trigger and Token; no manual replacement was used.

rows.why_pending: Ashuna activation and Wyrm-only restriction are proven, but the engine-defined expiry boundary is not asserted.

rows.required_observation_evidence: Candidate legality before activation, Wyrm-only restriction after activation, and restriction removal after the actual engine expiry boundary.
rows.notes: Expiry is taken from the engine-defined candidate-domain transition, not a fixed step count.
